import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
acc['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(acc.date, format='%m/%d/%Y')
key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

# daily total vs 7-day rolling median of prior days
daily = acc.groupby('dt')['unblended_cost'].sum()
# expected for 9/22 = median of prior 14 days (excluding 9/22)
prior = daily[daily.index < '2025-09-22'].tail(14)
print("expected ~", prior.median(), "actual 9/22:", daily['2025-09-22'])
print("excess:", daily['2025-09-22'] - prior.median())

# excess by resource: on_922 minus each resource's typical (median) daily cost
med = acc[acc.dt<'2025-09-22'].groupby(key)['unblended_cost'].median()
dayg = acc[acc.dt=='2025-09-22'].groupby(key)['unblended_cost'].sum()
ex = pd.concat({'med': med, 'on922': dayg}, axis=1).fillna(0)
ex['excess'] = ex.on922 - ex.med
print(ex.sort_values('excess', ascending=False).head(15))
print("total excess:", ex.excess.sum())
